column6: 大ボスで{08:7B}{01:08}を倒し、拠点だ{08:51}都庁を奪回！\n<wait>
column7: Baal is dead, and the Government Office is ours!\n<wait>
column8: reads: 大ボスであるバエルを倒し、拠点だった都庁を奪回！\n<wait> @from-ours

column6: くーーっ！！　や{08:51}{08:52}感じだな！！\n<wait>
column7: I feel like we can do anything!!\n<wait>
column8: reads: くーーっ！！　やったって感じだな！！\n<wait> @from-v005

column7: Fuck it, let's just take entire Shinjuku back!!\n<wait>
column8: reads: ここまですれば、もう、新宿を悪魔共の手から、取り戻したも同然だよ！！\n<wait> @from-v005

column7: Now that Baal is dead, the remaining demons must be quivering.\n<wait>
column8: reads: ボスであるバエルを倒した今、もはや、残された悪魔共など、恐れるに足りん！\n<wait> @from-ours

column7: At last, it is time for us humans to liberate ourselves!\n<wait>
column8: reads: 我々人間は、ようやく自らの力で、悪魔の支配から解放されるのだ！！\n<wait> @from-v005

column6: 代々木に、新たな強制労働{02:02}が出来{08:50}しいが、何も心配{08:8E}事は{08:25}。\n<wait>
column7: I hear that a new labour camp has been established in Roppongi.\nHowever, I'm not scared in the slightest.\n<wait>
column8: reads: 代々木に、新たな強制労働キャンプが出来たらしいが、何も心配する事はない。\n<wait> @from-v005

column6: {02:0C}の力をも{08:52}すれば、解放など造作も{08:25}わ！！\n<wait>
column7: Whatever they build, we will tear it down!!\n<wait>
column8: reads: 我々の力をもってすれば、解放など造作もないわ！！\n<wait> @from-v005

column7: I cannot thank Pentagramma enough for saving us.\n<wait>
column8: reads: 新宿労働キャンプを解放して、私達を助けてくれた、貴方達ペンタグランマには、\n本当に感謝しているわ。\n<wait> @from-ours

column6: あそこ{08:62}本当に地獄の様な場所だ{08:51}{02:08}\n<wait>
column7: Had it not been for them, we would never have regained our freedom.\n<wait>
column8: reads: あそこは、本当に地獄の様な場所だった‥‥‥\n<wait> @from-v005

column7: Now, if only I could stop seeing these nightmares...\n<wait>
column8: reads: でも、まだ悪夢から解放された訳じゃない。\n<wait> @from-v005

column6: ベッドに横たわると思い出すの。\n{08:0B}共や{01:08}兵達に、弄ば{08:60}あの日々をね{02:08}。\n<wait>
column7: Every night when I close my eyes, I see it.\nThe pain, the torture...It all comes back to me.\n<wait>
column8: reads: ベッドに横たわると思い出すの。\n悪魔共やバエル兵達に、弄ばれたあの日々をね‥‥‥。\n<wait> @from-v005

column6: {08:0B}{08:6A}て所詮{08:62}ちょ{08:53}やっかいな、猛獣み{08:4E}なもんさ！\n<wait>
column7: Demons really are just like animals in the end.\n<wait>
column8: reads: 悪魔なんて所詮は、ちょっとやっかいな、猛獣みたいなもんさ！\n<wait> @from-v005

column6: 狩るコツさえ覚{08:41}ら、ちょろいちょろい！！\n<wait>
column7: Once you learn how to hunt them, they're done for!\n<wait>
column8: reads: 狩るコツさえ覚えたら、ちょろいちょろい！！\n<wait> @from-v005

column6: 篭城にはてこず{08:51}{08:84}、都庁を落とす事が出来た{08:5F}{08:5E}。\n次{08:42}だ{08:52}、必ず上手く行くわ！\n<wait>
column7: It wasn't easy, but in the end, we were able to take back\nthe Governmental Office. The future is looking bright for us!\n<wait>
column8: reads: 篭城にはてこずったけど、都庁を落とす事が出来たんだもの。\n次からだって、必ず上手く行くわ！\n<wait> @from-v005

column7: Soon, it won't be the demons who are ruling the world!\n<wait>
column8: reads: もう、悪魔が地上を、大きな顔をして支配する時代は、終わったのよ！\n<wait> @from-v005

column6: 祝杯をあげる気分{08:52}の{08:62}いつだ{08:52}最高だな。\n<wait>
column7: There's no greater feeling than raising a toast.\n<wait>
column8: reads: 祝杯をあげる気分ってのは、いつだって最高だな。\n<wait> @from-v005

column6: 勝利の重さが大きければ、大きいほど、飲む酒の味も{08:4D}{08:74}美味く{08:59}{08:72}\nふぅ、たまらんね！！\n<wait>
column7: The tougher the battle, the sweeter the booze tastes afterwards!\n<wait>
column8: reads: 勝利の重さが大きければ、大きいほど、飲む酒の味もそれだけ美味くなる‥‥\nふぅ、たまらんね！！\n<wait> @from-v005

column7: Try all you might, a demon is still a demon at the end of the day.\n<wait>
column8: reads: どうあがいたところで、悪魔は、悪魔でしかない。\n<wait> @from-v005

column7: No way could they hope to stand up against us humans!\n<wait>
column8: reads: しょせんは、人間の敵じゃあ無かったって事だ！\n<wait> @from-v005
reads: 私は、まだ恐ろしいの‥‥‥‥\n<wait> @from-v005

column6: 確かに、{01:08}を倒{08:4B}事は大きいけれど、第二、第三の{01:08}が、\n現われ{08:25}とも限ら{08:25}でしょ？\n<wait>
column7: Sure, taking down Baal was a massive accomplishment,\nbut who's to say that there isn't going to be a second Baal? Or a third?\n<wait>
column8: reads: 確かに、バエルを倒した事は大きいけれど、第二、第三のバエルが、\n現われないとも限らないでしょ？\n<wait> @from-ours

column6: {08:4D}に、{08:0B}は案外プライドが高いわ。\n仕返しに遭{08:51}り{08:4B}ら{02:08}ああ、恐ろしいわ！！\n<wait>
column7: That's not to even mention that demons are prideful creatures.\nIt wouldn't surprise me if they were planning on taking revenge.\n<wait>
column8: reads: それに、悪魔は案外プライドが高いわ。\n仕返しに遭ったりしたら‥‥‥ああ、恐ろしいわ！！\n<wait> @from-v005

column7: I'm a little slow and don't really understand... <wait>but if Baal is dead,\nthat means that there's nothing for us to fear anymore, right?\n<wait>
column8: reads: アタシ、難しいコトはよく分かんないけどぉ、\n<wait>バエルを倒したんなら、もう怖いモンなしって感じぃ？\n<wait> @from-ours

column6: 自由{08:52}素敵よねぇ！　うふふふ！\n<wait>
column8: reads: 自由って素敵よねぇ！　うふふふ！\n<wait> @from-v005
reads: そこで、大人しくしていろ！\n<wait> @from-v005

column7: What the fuck... We risk our lives escaping Roppongi,\nand this is how we're greeted?\n<wait>
column8: reads: ‥‥‥一体何なんだ‥‥‥‥\n死ぬ程の思いをして、代々木から脱出してきたらこの仕打ちだ。\n<wait> @from-v005

column7: I doubt that they were joking about that whole execution thing.\nWe've seriously gotta do something!\n<wait>
column8: reads: こうしちゃいられない！\nこのまま大人しくしていたら、明日処刑されちまう！\n<wait> @from-v005

column7: Hmm... Is there anyway for us to escape...\n<wait>
column8: reads: 何とか脱出しなければ‥‥‥‥！\n<wait> @from-v005

column7: You and Sonoda slam yourselves against the door.\n
column8: reads: 園田と協力して、ドアをこじ開けにかかった。\n @from-v005

column7: Sonoda attempts to force the door open.\n{1E10:01003C}However, it's locked from the outside, and doesn't as much as budge.\n<wait>
column8: reads: 園田は、何とかドアをこじ開けようと試みた‥‥‥\n{1E10:01003C}が、しかし、外側からロックされたドアはびくともしなかった。\n<wait> @from-v005

column6: 駄目か{02:08}‥\n他に脱出できそうな所は{02:08}\n<wait>
column8: reads: 駄目か‥‥‥‥\n他に脱出できそうな所は‥‥‥\n<wait> @from-v005

column6: 他に脱出できそうな箇所を捜すが、どこにも見当{08:50}{08:19}。\n<wait>
column7: You look around,\nbut can't find anything that could be used to escape.\n<wait>
column8: reads: 他に脱出できそうな箇所を捜すが、どこにも見当たらなかった。\n<wait> @from-v005

column7: No, I refuse! I'm not going down without a fight!\n<wait>
column8: reads: こうなりゃどうにでもなれだ！\n処刑でも何でもされてやるッ！\n<wait> @from-v005

column7: You escaped the labour camp only to be immediately imprisoned.\n<wait>
column8: reads: 死ぬほどの思いをして、代々木労働キャンプから脱出し、戻ってきた途端に\nこの仕打ちである‥‥‥‥。\n<wait> @from-v005

column7: Just what has happened to the Resistance?\n<wait>
column8: reads: 一体、レジスタンスに何があったというのだ‥‥‥\n<wait> @from-v005

column7:
If you don't do something, then come tomorrow morning,
you will be executed for a crime you did not commit.
<wait>You have no choice. You've gotta escape.
<wait>

column7: It seems that if you wish to get out,\nit's going to have to be through that door.\n<wait>
column8: reads: この部屋から出るには、入ってきたドアを通るしかないようだ‥‥‥\n<wait> @from-v005

column7: It is there that the door opens and a person slips in.\n<wait>
column8: reads: その時、そっとドアが開かれ、滑り込むようにして人が入ってきた。\n<wait> @from-v005

column6: 助けに来たわ{02:08}‥\n大きな声を立てちゃ駄目よ{02:08}\n<wait>
column7: Yo, we're here to rescue you.\n<wait>
column8: reads: 助けに来たわ‥‥‥‥\n大きな声を立てちゃ駄目よ‥‥‥\n<wait> @from-v005

column7: Nekogal's voice is barely audible as she whispers to you.\nIt's quite obvious that they lack permission to be here.\n<wait>
column8: reads: 猫娘は、声をひそめて話しだした‥‥‥\n<wait> @from-v005

column7: Ever since that demon incident, something's happened to Watanabe.\nHe's almost like... a completely different person.\n<wait>
column8: reads: あの、悪魔襲撃事件があってから、渡邊は人が変わってしまったようだわ‥‥‥\n<wait> @from-v005

column7:
The demon's completely caught us off-guard.
<wait>I guess it was too much for his ego to take.
He needed someone to blame for it. A scapegoat.
<wait>
column8: reads: 悪魔の奇襲を受けてしまった‥‥\n<wait>と言う事実が、リーダーにとって、ショックだったのかも知れないが‥‥\n<wait> @from-v005

column7: We have no intention of betraying the Leader. He's our boss, after all.\n<wait>At the same time, we can hardly just watch by as you guys get executed.\n<wait>
column8: reads: 俺達、完全にリーダーを裏切る気は無いんだ。\n<wait>だけど、あんた達の事はほっとけないよ。\n<wait> @from-v005

column6: {01:08}を倒{08:4B}ヤツが、何で{08:0B}の手先になれ{08:5F}よ！\n<wait>
column7: You defeated Baal. There's no way you'd be working with the demons!\n<wait>
column8: reads: バエルを倒したヤツが、何で悪魔の手先になれんだよ！\n<wait> @from-ours

column6: さあ、{08:48}を飲んでくれ。\n俺の作{08:51}薬だ。こう見え{08:54}腕は確かだ{08:42}な。\n<wait>
column7: Here, drink this. It's a special medicine I mixed for you.\n<wait>
column8: reads: さあ、これを飲んでくれ。\n俺の作った薬だ。こう見えても腕は確かだからな。\n<wait> @from-v005

column6: 見てくれは悪いが、強力な{03:10}薬だ。\n遠慮せずに、飲んでくれ。\n<wait>
column7: It might look awful, but it's going to restore you to full health.\nGo ahead, quickly.\n<wait>
column8: reads: 見てくれは悪いが、強力な回復薬だ。\n遠慮せずに、飲んでくれ。\n<wait> @from-v005

column6: たとえ死んでた{08:52}、{08:7A}に時間が経{08:52}なきゃ蘇生さ{08:2A}ぜ！\n<wait>
column7: It can even bring the dead back to life.\n<wait>
column8: reads: たとえ死んでたって、そんなに時間が経ってなきゃ蘇生させるぜ！\n<wait> @from-v005

column6: 外に、ジープを１台スタンバイ{02:0D}{08:7B}。\n{08:4D}で、逃げてくれ。\n<wait>
column7: There's a jeep waiting for you outside of the base.\nYou can use it to get away.\n<wait>
column8: reads: 外に、ジープを１台スタンバイさせてある。\nそれで、逃げてくれ。\n<wait> @from-v005

column7: Of course, if only the two of you run away,\nthen she's likely the one who will be blamed next.\n<wait>
column8: reads: あんた達だけが逃げたら、この娘がどんな目に遭うかわかったもんじゃないわ。\n<wait> @from-v005

column7: You should take her with you.\n<wait>
column8: reads: この娘も連れて逃げなさい！\n<wait> @from-v005

column6: ありがと！　猫娘さん！\n<wait>
さあ、早く！　今、{08:45}の辺り{08:42}人を遠ざけて{08:7B}。\n今のうちに！\n<wait>
column7: Now then, hurry.\nIt's only a matter of time until someone figures out what's going on.\n<wait>
column8: reads: さあ、早く！　今、ここの辺りから人を遠ざけてある。\n今のうちに！\n<wait> @from-v005

column7: You thank the people before heading outside with Sonoda and Rui.\n<wait>
column8: reads: は礼を言い、園田、泪と共に外へ向かって駆け出した‥‥\n<wait> @from-v005 @rebase-tagdiff

column7: Boooriiing! Why do I have to be on duty while everyone else parties?\n<wait>
column8: reads: つまんなーい！　何でみんなが騒いでるときに、アタシ達だけ当直なのよ！！\n<wait> @from-v005

column6: まあ、そう言うな。少し{08:8F}差し入れを貰{08:51}ぞ。\n<wait>
column7: Come on, don't say that. Here, I snuck out some booze for us.\n<wait>
column8: reads: まあ、そう言うな。少しだが差し入れを貰ったぞ。\n<wait> @from-v005

column8: reads: ああ、だがハメを外すんじゃないぞ‥‥\n<wait> @from-v005

column7: Thank god the demons didn't attack...\nWe would've been in deep shit...\n<wait>
column8: reads: 今、悪魔が攻めてきたらどんな事になるか‥‥\n<wait> @from-v005

column8: reads: おっ、丁度良いところに来た。\n俺がたった今、合成した酒なんだ。\n<wait> @from-v005

column7: Try it out, would ya?\n<wait>I guarantee that it tastes great!\n<wait>
column8: reads: 試飲してみてくれよ！\n<wait>美味いはずだぜぇ！\n<wait> @from-v005

The man hands you a glass filled with a suspicious liquid.

falling on the ground before you are able to grab it.
